Top News
 
 
 
 
Douglas Rissing/iStock via Getty Images
 
 
 Wall Street ended the trading week higher, as the Federal Reserve's meeting minutes reaffirmed a hawkish stance, a massive SpaceX ( SPCX ) deal rattled telecom stocks, and AI infrastructure players faced fresh scrutiny over revenue expectations.

 The Federal Open Market Committee's September meeting minutes revealed united support for the central bank's tightening cycle, with officials highlighting upside risks to inflation and cementing market expectations for prolonged higher rates. 

SpaceX’s ( SPCX ) $8B deal to buy a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio from Grain Management sparked a selloff in major telecom stocks , like AT&T ( T ) and Verizon ( VZ ).

The broader AI sector faced a reality check after OpenAI ( OPENAI ) revised its annualized revenue expectations downward, triggering heavy investor scrutiny over the sustainability of massive infrastructure capital expenditures. 

For the week ended Oct. 9, the blue-chip Dow ( DJI ) rose +0.9% , the benchmark S&P ( SP500 ) gained +1.2% , and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( COMP:IND ) increased +0.6% .

Read a preview of next week's major events in Seeking Alpha's Catalyst Watch .


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Consumer
 
 
 
 Low confidence 
 
 
 
Seeking Alpha
 
 
Americans' confidence in food safety has dropped to a new low, a recent Gallup survey showed, and they are less confident in the federal government's oversight of food supply as well. The findings come as headlines on food recalls keep popping up, while this year saw an significant rise in foodborne illnesses. Consumer concerns were also reflected in restaurant foot traffic. Read more.

Dow +0.9% to 51,655. S&P 500 +1.2% to 7,812. Nasdaq +0.6% to 27,366. Russell 2000 -0.9% to 2,807. CBOE Volatility Index -3.1% to 14.84. 

 S&P 500 Sectors 
Consumer Staples +4% . Utilities +3.9% . Financials +2.3% . Telecom +0.8% . Healthcare +2.8% . Industrials -0.4% . Information Technology -0.3% . Materials +1.4% . Energy +3.6% . Consumer Discretionary +3.1% . Real Estate +1.8% . 

 World Indices 
London +0.9% to 10,552. France -1.2% to 7,803. Germany -0.6% to 25,087. Japan +1.1% to 69,031. China -0.7% to 3,814. Hong Kong +1% to 24,211. India +0.8% to 72,472. 

 Commodities and Bonds 
Crude Oil WTI +0.6% to $91.66/bbl. Gold +1.4% to $4,220.3/oz. Natural Gas +5.4% to 3.2. Ten-Year Bond Yield -0.2 bps to 5.244. 

 Forex and Cryptos 
EUR/USD -0.46% . USD/JPY +0.3% . GBP/USD -0.08% . Bitcoin -2.3% . Litecoin -9.1% . Ethereum -7% . XRP -5% . 

 Top S&P 500 Gainers 
PTC ( PTC ) +35% . Crown Castle ( CCI ) +20% . Moderna ( MRNA ) +18% . Constellation Energy ( CEG ) +16% . Vistra ( VST ) +15% . 

 Top S&P 500 Losers 
Intel ( INTC ) -12% . The Mosaic ( MOS ) -11% . Teradyne ( TER ) -10% . Skyworks Solutions ( SWKS ) -10% . C.H. Robinson Worldwide ( CHRW ) -10% .
